quote: A hungry child cannot learn; a fed child can change the world
explanation: Basic material security food, shelter, safety is not separate from the project of education and development; it is a prerequisite without which all other investments fail.
long_explanation:
Caring for ourselves changes how we show up for others.

Good physical and community health allows every person to learn, work, and contribute meaningfully to those around them.

Promoting health awareness and preventive well-being is an essential aspect of Jalte Diye Foundation's holistic community support.

Encourage a healthy habit or share a nutritious meal with someone today.
